title: Posts and messages
summary: Read posts and open private conversations from Messages.
body: Choose Messages in the sidebar to follow people, post, reply, repost and save posts. Use the Messages button above the feed to open your private inbox and choose a recipient.

title: Create from a conversation
summary: Create a task, event or project from a post or message.
body: Open the post actions menu and choose Create task, event or project. Replies and private messages have the same action. Choose a title, date and optional project. The source stays linked and keeps its original audience.

title: Calendar and Timeline
summary: Choose a date view or a schedule view.
body: Calendar shows events by month, week, day or agenda. Timeline shows plans and project tasks across dates. Switch between them from Calendar.

title: Using @mentions and #topics
summary: Autocomplete and linking for people and topics while writing.
body: Type @ to search people and # to search topics while composing a post, reply, or DM. Choose from the live suggestion list with the keyboard or mouse. Mentions link to profiles and topics link to topic feeds once published.

title: Using slash help
summary: Type / while writing to search support notes and product help.
body: Slash search is for support and help. Type / to search product notes while composing. For example, /@ shows help about mentions, /# shows help about topics, and /support shows general help. This is different from @people and #topics, which insert real handles and topics into the message.

title: Templates
body: Browse your templates or community templates in Marketplace. Use a template to schedule its steps around a date. The preview shows preparation, the event itself and follow-up tasks.

title: Post order
summary: Following is chronological. Discover shows a broader selection.
body: Following shows your posts, followed accounts and their reposts in time order. Discover includes other visible posts. Saved contains your bookmarks. Use Load more posts to continue reading.

title: Find help
summary: Search Help or type / in a message.
body: Search this page for a feature or task. While writing a message, type / to find related help.

title: Budgets, payments and receipts
summary: Allocate a budget, plan costs and record payments.
body: Money Overview compares project budgets in a table. Save selected projects as a group. Open a project budget to add allocations and costs. Record payment against an unpaid cost to track partial spending. In Activity, Link to cost reconciles an older payment without duplicating the cost. Use Receipts to attach a photo or PDF.

title: Use a template
summary: Choose steps and preview their dates.
body: Choose Use template, then a new project, an existing project or My plans. Set the event date, select the steps to include and check the dated preview before adding them.

title: Choose who sees a message
summary: Only me, followers, everyone, or project members.
body: Choose an audience before saving or sharing. Only me saves a private note. Followers shares with your followers; Everyone publishes to the public feed. Project members is available when a project is selected. Linking an existing message to a new plan keeps its original audience.
